prompt: Before sharing chat transcripts with a vendor, remove phone numbers, emails and card numbers.
tells: remove phone numbers, emails and card numbers
why: PII detection finds and redacts personal information.
trap: Plain entity recognition labels things but isn't built to redact personal data.

prompt: Application logs sometimes contain customers' names and addresses. Mask them before storing.
why: Detecting and masking personal data is PII detection.
trap: Privacy is the principle; PII detection is the tool.

prompt: A contact center wants Social Security numbers bleeped out of call transcripts.
why: Redacting personal identifiers is PII detection, even on transcribed speech.
trap: Transcription is the first step; redaction is the ask.

prompt: Before fine-tuning on support tickets, the team wants personal details removed so the model can't memorize them.
why: Strip PII from training data with PII detection.
trap: Content filters target harmful content, not personal data.

prompt: Before chat logs go into an analytics warehouse, credit-card numbers and home addresses must be replaced with placeholders.
why: Detecting and masking personal data is PII detection.
trap: Privacy is the principle; PII detection is the feature.

prompt: Mask passport numbers and bank account numbers in emails, but leave product names and order numbers as they are.
tells: leave product names and order numbers as they are
why: PII detection lets you pick which categories of personal data to redact.
trap: Entity recognition would label products too; the goal is hiding personal data.

prompt: Medical notes shared with researchers must have patient names, birthdates and record numbers removed.
tells: patient names, birthdates and record numbers removed
why: Removing identifying details is PII detection and redaction.
trap: Privacy is the principle; PII detection does the removal.

prompt: Recorded calls are transcribed, and any card numbers the customer says must be removed from the transcript.
tells: must be removed from the transcript
why: Redacting personal data from text is PII detection.
trap: Transcription comes first; the task asked about is removal.
